claims: Prince Jackson and Bigi "Blanket" Jackson made a red carpet appearance together at the world premiere of the biopic Michael in Berlin on April 10, 2026.
The Michael movie premiere took place at the Uber Eats Music Hall in Berlin, Germany.
Prince Jackson wore a black suit with a red shirt.
Prince Jackson's outfit mirrored Michael’s 2002 "Dangerous" performance look.
Bigi "Blanket" Jackson wore a black suit with a gold-striped jacket and an armband honoring his father.
Prince Jackson and Bigi "Blanket" Jackson were joined by uncles Marlon Jackson and Jackie Jackson.
Jaafar Jackson plays Michael in the biopic.
Jaafar Jackson stars in the Michael biopic.
Paris Jackson was not in attendance at the premiere.
Paris Jackson previously expressed criticism of the film.
Paris Jackson stated she had zero involvement.
Janet Jackson was absent from the premiere.
The Michael biopic is set to hit theaters on April 24, 2026.
